title: Immortality Through Will
description: Read through the synopsis until the end and check out my personal review of this tale to better grasp its overarching themes.ᴥᴥᴥA MILLION YEARS OF SLAVERY. ONE SEED OF WILL.Silas has endured a million years as a slave within the Grand Library of the Heavenly Wizard World. After being reborn on a desolate Earth, he uncovers a pathway that no master can dominate: the Mentalist Will Path. To thrive in the universe beyond the heavens, he must build an empire, awaken a world, and instruct humanity in transforming conviction into strength. However, freedom comes at a cost, and something ancient lurks in the shadows.
